# dify_models (Data Source)

Lists models available in the workspace across providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List models in the workspace, optionally filtered by provider and type.
data "dify_models" "openai_llms" {
  provider_name = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  model_type    = "llm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `model_type` (String) Optional model type filter (e.g. `llm`, `text-embedding`, `rerank`, `speech2text`, `tts`).
- `provider_name` (String) Optional provider filter (e.g. `langgenius/openai/openai`).

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) List of models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `model` (String) Model name.
- `model_type` (String) Model type.
- `provider` (String) Provider id.
- `status` (String) `active` means usable now; anything else needs the provider set up.
